metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Nick in the cut, Egeon at two, a joke struck out, and the Rose yard for tomorrow.

yesterday: Nick holds under the note when he is left in peace. Her words stood. The sixth, and not before.
The thumb-biting is out. The play is two hours and a half. You gave Kemp no line to fill it, and you did not name Arthur to him.
Egeon is played, in the gown you had.
The joke is struck out. It leaned on a workman being stupid, and it does not stand.
There are six, and a lion. You have not written the head or the ass. Field has not heard the pages.
Tomorrow you are out of Fair Em. You mean to stand in the Rose yard. The bill is a king of that name.
Term is at its last morning, and the almanac is still waiting for a mark.
